title: Doric's Task II (miniquest)
start: Speak to Doric in his hut just outside the gates of Taverley north of Falador.

steps.t: Speak to Doric in his hut north of Falador. [Chat: 1 Do you have any more Smithing tasks for me? › Accept]

sub.t: Make sure you are smithing chainbodies, not platebodies.
Purchasing chainbodies from the Grand Exchange will not complete the task.

steps.t: Deliver the chainbodies to Commander Denulth, north-east of Burthorpe lodestone. [Chat: 1 Ask about Doric's Tasks]

sub.t: There are breaks in the dialogue. Make sure the conversation is completed.

steps.t: Return to Doric and speak to him. [Chat: 1 Do you have any more Smithing tasks for me?]
Have 2 unnoted bronze bars in your inventory.
Use the anvil in the same room as Doric to make the cannon repair part.
Return to Burthorpe and head north to the castle. Outside the castle, climb the ladder west of the entrance to reach the roof.
Repair the middle broken cannon to the north.
Return to Commander Denulth. [Chat: 1 I've fixed the cannon.]
